policy: Pinned snapshots copied into this repository. Nothing is imported from the reference repository at build time or runtime.

sources.used: Authored Case Pack shape: pack { id, name, nameEn, version, cases }; case { id, title, titleEn, recommendedEntry, indexDateTime, chiefComplaint, patient, persona { version, content }, visibleHistory, indexConditions, laboratories }; lab observation { id, codings, value, unit, unitDisplay, interpretation, referenceRange }.
patientPersonaContentSchema fields (chiefComplaint, openingStatement, knownHistorySummary, symptomExperience, medicationMemory, persona { character, speechStyle, healthLiteracy, attitude }).
Coding systems (ICD-10, LOINC 2.83, WS/T 886-2026) and the WBC, RBC, hemoglobin and platelet codings copied verbatim; visible-history medication entry style for amlodipine.

Golden Case 1 clinical content: patient, queue registration, allergy, chronic condition, visible history (with department), persona replies, Physical Examination findings, laboratory and imaging results, scripted Report amendments and debrief reference.

notes: The reference repository has no community-acquired pneumonia case at this commit, so Golden Case 1 is authored here following its schema.

Fields added beyond the reference schema, per the Phase 1 spec: registration, triage, allergies, chronicConditions, visibleHistory[].department, physicalExamination, laboratories[].catalogItem, textResults, reportAmendments, debriefReference.

Pack version 2026-11-24.2 adds the chronic problem list (chronicConditions) and the prior-visit department for the patient banner and its health-record popover, both taken from the prototype's HISTORY block; the department moved out of the 2015 visit's reasonText.
Reference fields omitted as inpatient/PCI-specific: plannedStentCount, angiography, ttes, ecgs.
LOINC codings for neutrophil %, lymphocyte %, CRP and procalcitonin are authored here, not copied.
Case, patient and persona ids are diagnosis-neutral (golden-case-01, golden-patient-01) because they reach the browser; the reference repo's descriptive id style would leak Case Truth (ADR-0002).

sources.used: :root and .dark color tokens (background through ring), --radius, --font-ui and --font-code fallbacks, and --clinmesh-glow.

notes: Light and dark values are folded into light-dark() pairs; the dsw design-system variable indirection is dropped and its fallback values kept.
Sidebar, chart and font-scale tokens are not copied yet.
